description: In combination with `scen7-vl-SST`, quantifies the effective radiative forcing (ERF) of a failure of ozone precursor mitigation. Same as `scen7-vl-SST`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor (NMVOCs, CO, NOx) emissions follow `scen7-h`, and methane follows `scen7-h` in the chemistry scheme only (it follows `scen7-vl` in the radiation scheme).
